Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Isha - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Vimla - 68 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Aditya - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan nods.]

Neeta (gently): "Good job, Rohan!"

[Rohan trips over a stone.]

Neeta: "Let's see."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Rohan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[A hailstorm begins.]

Neeta: "Rohan, look at this."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Neeta: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
